tips: Cheapest live train pair (28 Nov): Jayakarta 290 out on 4 Dec (Pasar Senen 17:15, arr 00:45, Rp340k) + Jayakarta 289 back on 5 Dec (19:05, home 03:11, Rp240k) = about Rp580k, no hotel. Both Tersedia.
Progo is still sold out on both 4 and 6 Dec. Bengawan (Rp74k) sold out too. Taksaka 34 and 32 on 4 Dec are down to 8 seats each - if you want the Taksaka overnight, buy soon.
Singasari 149 on 5 Dec has seats again (economy Rp360k, was sold out on 26 Nov). Batavia 125 economy Rp380k overnight to Gambir is another cheap way home.
Bus and shuttle fares other than the 4 Dec exec bus are from 26 Nov and not rechecked today. Flight fares are from a tiket.com route listing and not date-checked - treat both as estimates.

Flying only makes sense if you value the 1h10 flight over the transfer: YIA is 40+ km from Jogja (train to Tugu Rp20k-50k, taxi Rp200k-280k). With transfers it costs more than Taksaka and takes similar total time.

Bus coverage fix (28 Nov 20:10 WIB): we had only read tiket.com, whose list shows about 20 rows per search, so evening buses like Sumber Alam (18:25, Pondok Pinang, Rp170k on Traveloka) never appeared. Traveloka's list also shows only about 20 rows, so other operators can still be missing.

Return by bus on 5 Dec: the Traveloka Sumber Alam rows visible leave Yogyakarta at 15:00-15:30, before the event ends at 17:00. Evening return buses were not seen in the first 20 rows, so they are unverified.

tips: Going the day before (11 Dec) is the safe plan: day trains arrive that evening and need one hotel night. Overnight trains that arrive by 06:30 on 12 Dec: Kertajaya 296 (01:06, Rp340k), Sembrani 58 (03:06), Bima 8 (03:21), Anggrek 4 (03:54), Jayakarta 290 (Gubeng 05:30, Rp380k), Pandalungan 42 (Gubeng 06:24, Rp640k).
Gumarang 178, Jayabaya 92 and Argo Anjasmoro 36 arrive 07:17 to 08:22 on event day, too late for the 08:00 start, so they are hidden.

Going back, event ends 15:00: Sat 12 Dec evening trains start at Pandalungan 41 / Bima 7 (about 19:10-19:18 from Gubeng), then Anggrek 3, Sembrani 57, Blambangan 145, Kertajaya 295, Dharmawangsa 179. Airlangga 305 is sold out.

Cheapest overall is a Sinar Jaya bus (about Rp225k), then Kertajaya trains (Rp340k). Direct flights cost about Rp1.26M-1.9M each way, and the only direct that lands in time on event day is Lion Air 03:30 from CGK.
Bus drop-off points differ by operator (Bungurasih, Medaeng, Kota Surabaya). Check the drop-off before buying, since each is a different distance from Jl. Semolowaru.
